Media queries and breakpoints
A media query applies CSS when a media condition such as viewport width is true.
Screen එJකේ width එක වුනි condition එකකේ true වුණාම @media ඇතුJළේ styles කික්‍රියාතේමක Jවනවා.
Layout එක කුJඩන්න පෙටන් ගන්න තුන අනුව breakpoint Jතහෝරන්න.
A product list switches to two columns on wider screens.
Read the diagram: Follow viewport width past the 700px breakpoint; the same cards reflow.
700px ට කලින් එකේ column එකයි. 700px සිට columns Jදකකේ Jවයි.
Expected result: At 699px one column; at 700px and above two columns.
Interview question: Should breakpoints be based only on popular device widths?
Answer: No. Choose them according to the content and layout needs.
Practice: Resize the viewport across 700px in DevTools.
